fusions.name: Tongue Snatch
fusions.desc: Flicks your tongue at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at the end of its reach. It has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Swallowed Whole
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Springs you onto a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 24 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shed Skin
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health to you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Gulp
fusions.desc: Each time you make a kill, you regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
